svg.aria-label: Code Fixer harness: an 11-phase ladder from Intake to Learn, with loops back to the Fix phase when checks fail
svg.text: Each rung must pass before the agent climbs. When a check fails, it loops back down.
Parse issue, stack traces, CI logs into a task spec
Clone repo, detect stack, build the Docker sandbox
Run the full suite before changing anything
Write a test that fails because of the bug
Stack trace + ripgrep + symbols give suspect files
Edit, run targeted tests, read failures, repeat
Full suite + lint + types, compared with baseline
Critic checks the diff; guard blocks test tampering
Push branch, open PR with root cause and results
Act on PR review comments and CI results
Save trajectory, repo memory and eval metrics
▲ Trigger: fixer run · issue label · red CI
Review → Fix: critic or tamper guard rejects
Feedback → Fix: review comments or red CI
Fix → Localize: stuck on the same failure
Guardrails on every rung: request & time budgets · stuck detection · provider failover · give up with a report
